response.overview: Jagadeesan, a con-man, is caught sleeping with his mafia boss Rajan's wife, Urvasi. Facing certain death, he begs for a few minutes to tell the story of the gun pointed at him.  The Chekhov 44, he claims, is a legendary weapon that has altered history across centuries, from Tsarist Russia to princely India. But Jagadeesan is a liar by trade, and Rajan knows it.  With a gun aimed at him, Jagadeesan's fate rests not on whether the story is true, but on whether Rajan believes it.
response.tagline: One Bullet. Two Lives. Three Stories.
response.title: Chekhov's Gun
